snippet.title: Zero Hour - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Zero Hour brings intense, tactical close-quarters combat to PlayStation 5 this fall.

Plan your approach, coordinate with your squad, and execute every breach with precision across high-risk tactical missions. Play solo with AI squadmates, team up with up to 10 players in online co-op, or compete in tactical 5v5 multiplayer with full cross-play support.

#ps5 #ps5games #zerohour 

Rated Mature
